title: OIS Ingestion Job Configuration Schema
description: Standard schema for declaring, scaling, and managing ingestion crawl jobs across vendors.

name.description: Unique identify name of the crawl job.

owner.description: Owner group or email responsible for the job.

schedule.description: Standard crontab schedule pattern indicating when to trigger the crawl job.

trigger.description: Execution trigger configuration for on-demand, agent-triggered (Agentic Ingestion / Migration), or event-driven job runs.

dryRun.description: When true, performs pre-crawl discovery and inspection without persisting chunks or migrating objects.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key to prevent duplicate job submissions.

requiresApproval.description: When true, places the job in PENDING_APPROVAL state requiring four-eyes administrative approval before execution.

delegatedIdentity.description: Delegated multi-agent identity context (OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange RFC 8693) bounding the job to the human user's source repository permissions.

onBehalfOf.description: Subject identifier (RFC 8693 'sub' / 'on_behalf_of') of the human user.

actorAgent.description: Actor identifier (RFC 8693 'act.sub') of the autonomous AI agent triggering the job.

scopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes authorized for this delegated execution.

scopeOverrides.description: Scoped repository path, query, or MIME-type filters narrowing the job execution.

folderPaths.description: Repository folder paths to include in the scoped scan.

queryFilter.description: Source-native query filter (e.g. CMIS SQL, SharePoint KQL, or S3 prefix).

maxDocuments.description: Maximum number of documents to process in this run.

type.description: Identifier of the source connector class (e.g. sharepoint-source, s3-source, cmis-source, bpmn2-source).

config.description: Connection endpoints, credentials reference, and connector-specific scan options.

governance.description: In-flight pre-embedding governance and PII redaction gate executed prior to chunking/vectorization or object migration.

defaultAction.description: Policy action to take when sensitive entities are detected.

failClosed.description: When true, halts document routing if the governance gate or external policy webhook is unreachable.

categories.description: Sensitive entity types to redact (e.g. EMAIL, SSN, CREDIT_CARD, PHONE, IBAN).

replacementToken.description: Mask token substituted for redacted spans.

webhookUrl.description: Optional external policy engine webhook URL returning ALLOW, REDACT, or DROP.

transformation.description: Configuration for document and metadata transformation (e.g., auto-narrativization) prior to chunking.

strategy.description: The technique used to transform metadata fields and variables into a semantic, human-readable text payload.

template.description: Mustache or standard text template mapping schema/metadata variables into a text payload.

model.description: Identifier of the AI embedding model name (e.g. mxbai-embed-large, nomic-embed-text, all-minilm).

provider.description: Embedding provider name (e.g. ollama, openai, huggingface).

endpoint.description: Service endpoint URL for the embedding provider.

type.description: Identifier of the destination writer connector class (e.g. pgvector, elasticsearch, milvus, ozone, s3).

sidecarEnabled.description: When writing to cloud/lakehouse object storage targets (e.g. Apache Ozone, AWS S3), persist a companion <key>.ois.json sidecar envelope alongside each raw binary object.

verifySha256.description: When true, compute and verify SHA-256 cryptographic checksums across source extraction and target object persistence.

config.description: Database targets, object storage buckets/volumes, table schemas, dimension values, and indexing options.
